stage: All ten LIBERO-Spatial tasks, independently refitted multitask policies; not the entire LIBERO benchmark
observation: two current RGB cameras; current 7 joint positions, 3 end-effector position, 3 orientation axis-angle, 2 gripper positions; task instruction tokens. No object-state or elapsed time input.
timing: Official HDF5 obs[t-1] matches states[t]. Pair it with action[t:t+8]. Drop t=0. Recovery observations are captured immediately before their executed actions.
policy: small shared camera CNN, spatial features, learned token embeddings, action-chunk MLP; trained from scratch, not a foundation VLA
initial_local_pilot_repeats: Three paired independent recovery-library/policy repetitions, all ten tasks required; no post-hoc task dropping.
phase_rule: Same task, normalized episode progress; an explicit adaptation from the ACT fixed-timestep neighborhood
amplitude_units: Native normalized controller units; separately RMS-normalize translation (0:3) and rotation (3:6). Native controller output limits recorded. Clip perturbation at three times amplitude and commanded action at native [-1,1].
amplitude_selection: Fixed 0.05 transferred from the three-task pilot before full-suite outcomes; not selected on new test data.
acceptance: Terminal task success under the official success predicate, in addition to ever-success diagnostic. Log all scales and failures; identity fallback separate.
mixture: Half original, half recovery sampled per batch; repeated-original control uses only original with same updates/batch size.
cost: Record GPU-training synchronized wall time and environment collection wall time separately, plus simulator steps. Reallocate auxiliary fitting cost to Gaussian policy updates on the same device. End-to-end budget equality requires measured accounting, not equal update counts alone.
gate: All 10 tasks retained. Development competence gate requires >=2/10 for every task; failure halts the full study before final test evaluation, never drops a task.
scope: Complete task coverage only for LIBERO-Spatial with this stated 40/10 demo split and 20 test initial states; not the default official lifelong-learning evaluation, LIBERO-Object, LIBERO-Goal, LIBERO-100, CALVIN, SimplerEnv, or foundation VLA.
training_budget_scaling: Pilot update budgets multiplied by 10/3 and rounded up to preserve approximate source exposure per task. All four final methods matched within this study; same-cost Gaussian uses total active wall time.
evaluation_reset: Each task/initial-state episode uses a newly constructed official environment, seeded before construction and reset. Clear episode history; save and pair both dynamic state and fixed-body poses plus initial RGB/proprioception. Required by drawer fixture reset reproducibility diagnostic.
